authorization.userStatement: Ninguna, suponla a traves del analisis de la pieza real y ejemplos de literatura
authorization.interpretation: Use explicit conditional hypotheses where specimen/mount/slider/experimental data are unavailable; do not manufacture measurements.

geometry.representation: unchanged connected original BREP; cap-derived conforming solid mesh
geometry.axes: canonical chord/span/height = CAD X/Z/Y; outward normals recomputed
geometry.spanEndsViscous: capped extrusion; open cavity flow is excluded

material.baseline: Malim2023 Tough PLA isotropic E=2.617 GPa rho=1160 kg/m3
material.orthotropy: directional reduction is a sensitivity, not identified printing axes or specimen law

supports.fixtureCompliance: finite spring sensitivity is conditional; no measured fixture stiffness

slider.evidence: parallel surfaces surrounding the internal bar and spanwise hole; prismatic monolithic connectivity remains
slider.C: mean chord translation free, other five coordinates fixed
slider.contactFriction: small-motion mean-coordinate proxy; mu and preload are engineering assumptions, not identified contacts

flow.UVLM_regime: incompressible attached small-disturbance; no resolved skin Cp or separated/turbulent deficit
flow.viscousRegime: own laminar 2D/3D MAC + Brinkman, explicit Re 20/100; tunnel-Re not extrapolated
flow.internalPressurePrimary: ambient in the eight open spanwise cavity ports identified from the original cap; optional vent-impedance sensitivity is a screening proxy
flow.internalPressureViscous: external-flow branch fills the envelope and caps its ends; no internal-flow prediction

gravity.primaryOrientation: span vertical; canonical gravity [0,-9.81,0] m/s2, assumed fixture orientation
gravity.windResponse: increment about zero-flow shape; small-strain linear K, no finite prestress stiffness correction
gravity.checkedOrientations: independent full FEM body loads along chord/span/height; mass-consistent gravity
